unsupported_license.title: Unsupported Veeam license on {host}
unsupported_license.description:
The Veeam Backup & Replication server at **{host}** reports the license **{license}**.

Veeam Community Edition, and servers with no license installed, are not supported by this integration: entitlements differ and some REST API endpoints answer differently or not at all, so entities may be missing or unreliable.

The integration keeps running — nothing is blocked. If you hit problems, please include this license edition in your bug report. Install a supported license, or remove the integration, to clear this warning.

license_expiring.title: Veeam license on {host} expires soon
license_expiring.description:
The Veeam Backup & Replication license on **{host}** expires on {date}, in {days} days. Once it expires, backup jobs stop processing new data, after any grace period your license type allows.

Install a renewed license in the Veeam Backup & Replication console. This warning clears on its own once the new license is reported.

license_expired.title: Veeam license on {host} has expired
license_expired.description:
The Veeam Backup & Replication license on **{host}** expired on {date}. Backup jobs have stopped processing new data, or will once any grace period your license type allows has ended.

Install a renewed license in the Veeam Backup & Replication console. This warning clears on its own once the new license is reported.
